# was associated with

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:wasAssociatedWith`](gmeow-wasAssociatedWith.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/wasAssociatedWith>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an activity to an agent associated with carrying it out — e.g. the software agent that ran an import. ([`Activity`](../classes/gmeow-Activity.md)→[`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); the counterpart of [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md), which ascribes an endurant [`Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to an agent.)

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Activity`](../classes/gmeow-Activity.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:wasAssociatedWith`](gmeow-wasAssociatedWith.md) from [`gmeow:Activity`](../classes/gmeow-Activity.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to tie an activity to the agent that carried it out — the software agent that ran an import, the person who performed a transformation — the activity-side companion of [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for ascribing an enduring product to its author (use [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md) on the [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)) and for a role richer than bare association — promote to a participation relator when capacity or responsibility share matters.

### How to use

- Relate the [`gmeow:Activity`](../classes/gmeow-Activity.md) to its performing [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); record the activity's products through the inverse of [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md) and its time on the event, so performer, product, and timing stay separable.

### Examples
